body:
Check our all our organizations repositories:
- link-foundation
- linksplatform
- link-assistant
- konard (user)

For example:
- github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind
- github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai
- github.com/konard/documents-processing

Collect all logic and best practices we used for sanitation, and make sure we implement the most robust framework/library and cli on a the market to fully sanitize any text files like logs, AI sessions and so on.

We should be able to do sanitation of personal data (names, emails and so), but we should be able to do it smartly - if that includes some public popular people and public organizations and for example email was made public on the internet by organization itself we should be able to treat such data as not personal.

And all credentials (tokens, passwords and so on), which are clear from context.

The most important feature for this system is reliability so it must use all algorithms from competitors, or reimplement a more advanced algorithms here, so we bet exactly all open-source competitors in the field, and provide best possible sanitation for sensitive data on the market.

For closed source competitors we should use their docs and examples to support all their features as well.

We may also include tools to carefully redact / edit history of GitHub, to make sure sensitive data was removed from the history.

We should support as much natural languages as possible, and work with all their specifics. And as much popular services as possible where the format of credential tokens is known.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Collect all best practices we used to do sanitation of sensitive data from our projects
